All 7 findings are addressed. I read the fix diff and grepped for leftovers. I did not run any tests, so the RED-first order for finding 2 is unconfirmed.

**Findings**
1. ADDRESSED (hooks/views/pane.ts:~262-266). Non-agent pages now show `view.blurb` with no `· b <-` suffix. The agent page keeps "b goes back to <page>". tests/back-button.spec.ts has the new describe block: plain and bbs looks assert the `◂ Back to Overview` button and no `/b <-/` in the drawn text, and the agent page asserts `b goes back to Swarm`.
2. ADDRESSED (hooks/help-topics-core.ts:~174). It now reads "The Stop, New session and Clear buttons have no keys: click them." tests/key-labels.spec.ts has a new test scanning help-topics-core.ts and help-topics-more.ts for `s stops`, `o opens a new`, `z clears` and `press/tab to s|o|z`. I can't confirm from the diff that it was written RED first.
3. ADDRESSED.
   - Reworded: help-topics-more.ts:~201 ("Open the Room page"), README.md:~93 ("Safety → Room") and ask-claude.ts:~120 ("Read the Room feed").
   - group-scheme.spec.ts now has `retiredExact = ['The Room']`, matched case-sensitively, in the never-writes-a-retired-name test.
   - Remaining "The Room" hits are in comments and a spec header (hooks/data/room.ts, hooks/room.ts, views/common.ts, views/room.ts, tests/room.spec.ts), which the scan skips as comment lines. The one other hit is plugin.json:110, covered below.
4. ADDRESSED (tests/group-scheme.spec.ts:~394-395, 417-423). `found` is now at module scope: `escape` uses `/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g` with replacement `'\\$&'`, and the pattern is built with `String.raw`. A new test covers a planted name (true), "Cost & Budgeting" (false), "x-Cost & Budget" (false), "Open The Room" (true) and "Open the Room page" (false).
5. ADDRESSED (hooks/commands.ts:~148). The dump case now uses `viewOf(rest)`. tests/commands-verbs.spec.ts covers `dump learning lab` (neural), `dump claims board`, `text swarm` and bare `dump` (null).
6. ADDRESSED (tests/refresh-instant.spec.ts header). It now says the digit page keys, the keyed pages of the core tab strip (CORE_TABS) and p / r / h stay armed, and y / n still answer an ask. A matching test was added.
7. ADDRESSED.
   - CHANGELOG has `## 0.43.0 — 2026-10-10` on top, in the same `feat:` / `fix:` bullet format as 0.42.1.
   - Version is 0.43.0 in plugin.json:4, hooks/version.ts and scripts/smoke.sh (both lines).
   - A grep of the plugin's json, sh and md files and the root marketplace.json found no 0.42.1 outside the CHANGELOG's own 0.42.1 entry.
   - I did not check the changelog bullets against the whole branch beyond what the diff shows. They read as accurate for what I could see.

**Implementer notes**
- CORE_TABS exported from pane.ts for a test: acceptable. It is a read-only constant and the test ties the tab set to the armed keys.
- "The Room" banned only capitalised: acceptable. The test comment explains it, and the planted-case test pins both sides.
- plugin.json:110 still reads "The Room lists the sessions…": must fix, low severity. It is in the user-visible description of a plugin.json entry, and the page is now just "Room". Change it to "Room lists…". The scan doesn't cover it because it only walks hooks/*.ts.

**New breakage in the fix diff:** none seen.

**Out-of-scope observations**
- The "The Room" ban list only scans hooks/*.ts. Neither the README nor plugin.json is guarded.
- The back-button agent test depends on `readSnapshot` and `memoryFs` fixtures. It is fine if those are already imported in that spec.

**Verdict:** all findings addressed. One small follow-up remains: the plugin.json:110 wording.
